This Certificate does not bestow any form of legal international approval. R3-0033 Page 1 of 2 pages --- # Physikalisch-Technische Bundesanstalt OIML Certificate N° **R76/1992-DE1-07.07** The conformity was established by the results of tests and examinations provided in the associated Report No. 1.12-4030529 (13 pages) and the Test Report No. 1.12-4030529/1 that includes 42 pages.
The Issuing Authority The CIML Member
Dr. P. Zervos
Regierungsdirektor

20.08.2007		 Dr. R. Schwartz
Direktor und Professor

20.08.2007
Identification of the type (continued): Designed as weighbridge, road vehicle scale, rail-weighbridge, hopper scale, crane scale, overhead scale track as well as mobile instrument in conveyor systems. The weighing instrument is equipped with a lever system or directly introduces the force into one or more load cells. The weighing ranges comprising Max, verification scale intervals, number of verification scale intervals and scale intervals may be selected considering the limiting values in table 1. Table 1:
